about: Survey control. Positions are read off the measured building survey of the house (1:50 floor plans and 1:100 elevations, March 2025); the pixel picks say where the same places are in the footage. Add tape measurements under 'distances' as they are taken.
frame: Site grid, metres. Origin: the outer south-east corner of the rear outshot at ground level (where the low eaves end, by the back door). X runs south, away from the back of the house; Y runs east. z = 0 is level 20.00 m on the measured survey's datum.

levels.name: patio, 2.6 m south of the corner

far_field.about: The first clip was a pan from one spot, so everything seen only in it (the south and west of the garden) has good directions and weak distances. The first model's distances there turned out 9 to 30% short, by different amounts in different directions. They were corrected against a second viewpoint: the first seconds of clip h look back across the same ground from 7 m to the side (see sightings.json and triangulate.py).
